name: caliber-ui
description: Single-page application for the CALIBER MLflow plugin.

scripts.test:workflow-platform:smoke: vitest run --reporter=dot src/lib/__tests__/workflowRunLinks.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/workflowBakeoff.test.ts -t 'builds the canonical workflow run path|builds an absolute workflow run URL when an origin is provided|falls back to the relative path when the origin is invalid|parses workflow and run references from benchmark evidence text' && vitest run --reporter=dot src/components/workflows/__tests__/workflow-components.test.tsx -t 'configures knowledge query nodes with KB versions, AGE retrieval, and graph overrides|configures knowledge build nodes with launch controls and KB defaults|surfaces AGE-backed knowledge-query diagnostics inside the replay path|surfaces bounded loop diagnostics with polished node-type labels inside the replay path' && vitest run --reporter=dot src/pages/__tests__/knowledge-bases.test.tsx -t 'surfaces Apache AGE retrieval in the playground and sends the age_graph mode|runs AGE-backed retrieval directly from the graph tab' && vitest run --reporter=dot src/pages/__tests__/object-store.test.tsx -t 'launches the knowledge-base builder from the current folder with the AGE preset|shows the created column and opens a preview modal from the row action' && vitest run --reporter=dot src/pages/__tests__/workflow-studio.test.tsx -t 'hydrates a deep-linked run from workflow detail query params|supports cancel, retry, approve, and resume run actions from run details' && vitest run --reporter=dot src/pages/__tests__/workflow-editor-handlers.test.tsx -t 'handles quick-add/connect/map mutations and save/publish errors|matches waiting runs by external event from the run monitor|shows scheduled wait messaging and resumes wait_until runs without event payload' && vitest run --reporter=dot src/pages/__tests__/sidebar-build-routes.test.tsx && vitest run --reporter=dot src/pages/__tests__/app-shell-e2e.test.tsx -t 'renders workflow detail deep links through the real app router|resolves workflow run routes through the real app router|navigates across routes and refreshes sidebar badges from SSE-triggered summary reload'
